title: Legend of Wonder Woman #1 DC May 1986 Trina Robbins Kurt Busiek Reading Copy
condition_description: Reading copy: piece torn from the lower back cover (coupon area, text affected), chip and paper tear at the front spine edge, toning. Complete otherwise. See close-ups.
description:
The Legend of Wonder Woman #1 (of 4) (DC Comics, May 1986). Classic Golden Age-style Wonder Woman, cover and art by Trina Robbins, written by Kurt Busiek. 75c cover price.

Back cover: Monogram Lightning RC racer ad.

Condition: reading copy. A piece is torn from the lower back cover through the coupon area (some text missing), with a chip and paper tear at the front spine edge and toning (see close-ups). Front cover art is bright and intact.

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
